entries.title: Flattery and fanfare as Trump welcomed to China - but thorny issues remain
entries.snippet: The leaders of the world's two superpowers were all smiles for the cameras during the US president's visit to Beijing.

entries.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
entries.snippet: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

entries.title: Cuba says CIA chief visited Havana as energy crisis worsens
entries.snippet: The reported visit came after the US renewed an offer of aid to ease the effects of its oil blockade.

entries.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble of Kyiv flats after massive Russian strikes
entries.snippet: Two children are among at least 16 killed in Ukraine's capital in massive Russian drone and missile attacks, officials say.

entries.title: Giant new dinosaur identified from fossils in Thailand
entries.snippet: The nagatitan is the largest dinosaur found in South-East Asia and weighs as much as nine elephants.

entries.title: Latvian PM resigns after row over stray Ukrainian drones
entries.snippet: Drones bound for Russia crashed down in Latvia last week, prompting a political fallout.

entries.title: Warning of record global temperatures as chance of very strong El Niño grows
entries.snippet: As El Niño develops this year, scientists are increasingly confident it could be one of the strongest on record with global consequences, as Simon King explains.

entries.title: Five Italians die during cave dive in Maldives
entries.snippet: Italy says the incident happened at a depth of 50m. Maldivian rescuers have so far found one body.

entries.title: War criminal Ratko Mladić's jail release request denied
entries.snippet: A UN judge admits the 84-year-old is "in the final stages of his life", but says prison conditions in The Hague ensure his maximum comfort.

entries.title: 'Pretty miraculous' - 11 rescued after pilot ditches plane in Atlantic
entries.snippet: The survivors spent about five hours on a life raft before being rescued by the US Air Force off Florida's coast.

entries.title: Former Nigerian minister sentenced to 75 years in rare corruption verdict
entries.snippet: Former Power Minister Saleh Mamman was convicted last week - but the authorities do not know his whereabouts.

entries.title: 'They shot my neighbour in the head' - the lakeside city traumatised by war
entries.snippet: Rebel fighters and Rwandan troops are accused of committing atrocities after capturing the DR Congo city of Uvira in December.

entries.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
entries.snippet: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

entries.title: Court overturns Alex Murdaugh's murder convictions and orders new trial
entries.snippet: The court has ordered a new trial over the June 2021 killings of Paul and Maggie Murdaugh.

entries.title: Gunshots fired in Philippine Senate where lawmaker wanted by ICC is holed up
entries.snippet: Senator Ronald dela Rosa, a former police chief, enforced former President Rodrigo Duterte's deadly drug war.

entries.title: Woman isolating on British island in South Pacific after hantavirus contact
entries.snippet: The woman who was on a virus-hit ship shows "no signs of illness", the government of Pitcairn Islands, a British Overseas Territory, says.

entries.title: Dozens of dogs rescued and suspect arrested in Uganda after BBC investigation
entries.snippet: A BBC investigation exposed how scammers posted social content of dogs in distress to dupe donors into giving money.

entries.title: Epstein abused me while under house arrest, survivor tells US lawmakers
entries.snippet: Roza was among several victims who gave testimony to Democratic lawmakers on Tuesday.

entries.title: Shrinking Milka chocolate bar tricked consumers, says German court
entries.snippet: A court in Bremen has found the manufacturer of the classic Alpine Milk chocolate bar guilty of "shrinkflation".

entries.title: Passengers allowed to leave norovirus-hit cruise ship
entries.snippet: Passengers on the ship showing no symptoms are allowed to leave, authorities say, after 49 people fell ill from gastrointestinal sickness.

entries.title: The 10 best songs competing at (a very contentious) Eurovision
entries.snippet: Glitter, vocal gymnastics, on-stage flames — the show goes on on the Eurovision stage in Vienna, even though five countries are boycotting this year's contest due to Israel's participation.

entries.title: Native kids with disabilities were held in wooden boxes. Sweeping reforms are coming
entries.snippet: State officials in New York say the Salmon River district's special education program confined young children with disabilities in wooden boxes. Parents weren't notified.

entries.title: Some plants have unusual genetics, which can help them weather cataclysmic events
entries.snippet: Unlike humans, many plants have more than two sets of chromosomes. This trait may help them adapt to environmental upheaval, such as climate change.

entries.title: How AI is speeding new business creation, especially among Gen Z entrepreneurs
entries.snippet: Entrepreneurs are turning to AI to speed the creation of new businesses, with Gen Z leading the way. That's according to a new report from the payroll software firm Gusto.

entries.title: The Supreme Court keeps abortion pill mifepristone available by telehealth
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court ruled on Thursday that the abortion pill mifepristone can continue to be prescribed online or over the phone and sent through the mail.

entries.title: Linda McMahon defends dismantling the Education Department, shifting its work
entries.snippet: The education secretary faced questions about the shrinking of her agency, limits on federal student loan borrowing and oversight of the education of students with disabilities.

entries.title: Cuba's power grid collapses and plunges eastern provinces into a major blackout
entries.snippet: Cuba's aging power grid has eroded in recent years as it faces a prolonged economic crisis, made worse by a U.S. energy blockade of the island.

entries.title: Jury orders Boeing to pay $49.5 million to family of 737 MAX crash victim
entries.snippet: A federal jury in Chicago awarded $49.5 million to the family of Samya Stumo, a young woman who was killed in the second of two Boeing 737 MAX crashes within months of each other in 2018 and 2019.

entries.title: As Trump meets with Xi, security expert says China now faces the U.S. as a peer
entries.snippet: Former national security official Rush Doshi says President Trump's sky-high tariffs on Chinese goods sparked a clash in which China prevailed. We look at the current state of U.S.-China relations.

entries.title: Researchers unearth Southeast Asia's largest dinosaur
entries.snippet: They're calling it the "last titan" of Thailand. The sauropod — an herbivore with a long neck and tail — comes from the late Early Cretaceous period, some 100 to 120 million years ago.

entries.title: China offers Trump grand welcome, but issues warning on Taiwan
entries.snippet: Chinese leader Xi Jinping hosted President Trump and offered the U.S. a "new vision" of relations more focused on trade and collaboration than on confrontation. Trump in turn, offered a future in which he and Xi were "united and together." But China's president also had a stark w

entries.title: U.S.-China diplomatic reset faces unresolved 'contradictions,' expert warns
entries.snippet: Following the high-level talks between President Trump and Xi Jinping in Beijing, Nick Schifrin discussed a potential shift in the relationship between the U.S. and China with Orville Schell of the Center on U.S.-China Relations.

entries.title: Analysts break down Trump-Xi meeting and calls for stability and cooperation
entries.snippet: For perspective on President Trump's trip and the broader U.S.-China relationship, Geoff Bennett spoke with Myron Brilliant and Liza Tobin. Brilliant is at the DGA Group and is the former executive vice president of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. Tobin is a former intelligence off

entries.title: Supreme Court extends access to mifepristone, for now
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court again extended access to mifepristone, for now. Thursday, justices extended a pause on a lower court ruling that would have blocked telehealth prescriptions and mail distribution of the abortion pill. Amna Nawaz discussed what this means for people seeking the m

entries.title: How reality TV stars seeking office are changing politics
entries.snippet: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, his wife and their children filmed a reality show that is set to be released in the lead-up to the nation's 250th anniversary. It is a return to form for the Duffys, who first met filming for MTV in the 1990s. Now, a new batch of reality TV st

entries.title: Florida's controversial 'Alligator Alcatraz' expected to close
entries.snippet: The controversial "Alligator Alcatraz" camp for detained migrants in Florida is expected to close. White House correspondent Liz Landers reports on the Trump administration's immigration policies amid recent developments.

entries.title: Bellevue Literary Review celebrates 25 years of stories on illness and recovery
entries.snippet: Three doctors, two poets and a fiction writer walk into a windowless hospital conference room. Not the start of a joke, but of a prestigious journal, "Bellevue Literary Review", now celebrating its 25th anniversary. Senior arts correspondent Jeffrey Brown reports for our ongoing

entries.title: Supreme Court preserves access to widely used abortion pill, while lawsuit plays out
entries.snippet: The court's order allows women seeking abortions to continue obtaining the drug, mifepristone, at pharmacies or through the mail, without an in-person visit to a doctor. Access is likely to remain uninterrupted at least until into next year as the case plays out, including a pote

entries.title: Cuban government says CIA Director John Ratcliffe met with officials in Havana
entries.snippet: According to official reports, the meeting served as a platform for Cuba to present evidence asserting that the nation poses no threat to U.S. national security.

entries.title: Lebanon and Israel kick off new negotiations amid fighting with Hezbollah
entries.snippet: The Trump administration has been pushing for a breakthrough between the two neighbors that have been officially in a state of war since Israel was created in 1948.

entries.title: Louisiana senate passes new U.S. House map that would eliminate majority-Black district
entries.snippet: The new U.S. House districts, which still need House approval, would be used for primary elections poised to be postponed from Saturday until November. This as South Carolina's governor pushed for congressional redistricting and could call lawmakers into a special session.

entries.title: Oklahoma judge allows former death row prisoner to be released on bond while awaiting retrial
entries.snippet: The decision clears the way for Richard Glossip, 63, to leave a lockup for the first time since his arrest nearly 30 years ago over a 1997 killing that put him on the brink of execution three separate times. The U.S. Supreme Court threw out his conviction last year.

entries.title: Cuba's eastern province belted by major blackout after power grid collapse
entries.snippet: The state-run Electric Union said the collapse had stripped power from all eastern provinces from Guantánamo to Ciego de Ávila, and that crews were working to restore power, but it did not give an estimate for how long it would take.

entries.title: FBI Director Kash Patel took 'VIP snorkel' at a Pearl Harbor memorial, emails show
entries.snippet: With few exceptions, snorkeling and diving are off-limits around the USS Arizona. The battleship is now a military cemetery reachable only by boat. It has stood as one of the nation's most hallowed sites since Japan bombed and sank the ship in 1941. A Navy spokesperson confirms t

entries.title: Ultranationalist Jews recite racist slogans during march into Jerusalem's Old City
entries.snippet: Normally a bustling marketplace for Palestinian residents of east Jerusalem, the area was devoid of Palestinians, many of whom had barricaded themselves inside their homes and closed their shops for the day. The procession often leads to violent confrontations between ultranation

entries.title: Xi tells Trump U.S. and China could clash over Taiwan
entries.snippet: The exchange at a highly anticipated summit in Beijing underscored just how far apart Trump and Xi still are on thorny issues, including the war in Iran, trade disputes and Washington's relations with Taiwan, which is self-ruled but which China claims as part of its territory.

entries.title: Flotilla heads for Gaza after Israel intercepted last convoy
entries.snippet: More than 50 vessels departed from Marmaris on Thursday in what organizers call the final leg of their journey to Gaza. On April 30, Israeli forces intercepted a previous flotilla near Crete, initially detaining about 175 activists and transferring two to Israel for questioning.

entries.title: World Cup final halftime show to feature Madonna, Shakira and BTS
entries.snippet: The governing body said the show would support the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund, which is raising $100 million to help children access education and soccer. It will be curated by Coldplay's Chris Martin.

entries.title: U.S. Border Patrol head announces resignation in latest leadership shakeup
entries.snippet: Michael Banks of the U.S. Border Patrol told Fox News on Thursday that his resignation was effective immediately, saying "it's just time."

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: How international student tuition fees vary across Europe
entries.snippet: A French government plan to charge students from outside the EU 16 times more than previously have stoked discontent. But how does this compare to the rest of Europe, both inside the EU and out?

entries.title: Iran says Chinese ships passed through Hormuz overnight
entries.snippet: Chinese-flagged vessels were among over 30 ships that crossed the waterway, according to Iran's revolutionary guard. The statement comes as Trump tries to rally Beijing against Tehran during a state visit.

entries.title: China warns Trump over Taiwan question at high-stakes summit
entries.snippet: Chinese state media reported that Xi Jinping raised the question of Taiwan during his meeting with Donald Trump. The pair held talks for about two hours. Follow live.

entries.title: Ukraine: Over 20 dead as Russian strikes pound Kyiv
entries.snippet: Russia has unleashed a massive volley of missiles and drones at Ukrainian cities for the third day in a row, with the latest strikes hitting a Kyiv apartment block.

entries.title: Corruption in Ukraine: Will this scandal reach Zelenskyy?
entries.snippet: A drawn-out corruption affair in Ukraine is widening, with authorities now taking action against Andriy Yermak, the former head of the presidential office. Will this scandal reach all the way to President Zelenskyy?

entries.title: Cuba's power grid 'critical' as US blocks fuel shipments
entries.snippet: Protests flared in Havana amid widespread power outages. Cuba's energy minister says fuel has "run out" as a four-month US oil blockade chokes off energy supplies.

entries.title: UK: Health Secretary Wes Streeting resigns, likely in bid to topple PM Keir Starmer
entries.snippet: Two Labour Party politicians have positioned themselves to challenge Prime Minister Keir Starmer for the leadership. Health Secretary Wes Streeting resigned, and Angela Rayner said her tax affairs were back in order.

entries.title: Lab-grown Tyrannosaurus leather: More chicken than dinosaur?
entries.snippet: A handbag is promoted as the "world's first T. rex leather product." But scientists are questioning its authenticity.

entries.title: German intelligence offices snub US-based Palantir software
entries.snippet: Germany's domestic intelligence agency has reportedly chosen a data analysis system from France, instead of US-based Palantir. Civil society has welcomed the move, but says more must be done.

entries.title: Who is Mario Draghi, this year's Charlemagne Prize winner?
entries.snippet: The Charlemagne Prize honors those who advance European unity. This year's winner is Italy's Mario Draghi, a former European Central Bank chief and a key architect of European stability during a time of economic crisis.

entries.title: Angela Merkel rejects 'male-killing' label as 'absurd'
entries.snippet: Germany's first female chancellor, Angela Merkel, has spoken about her rise to the top. She rejected accusations that she ruthlessly pushed aside male rivals as "baseless."

entries.title: Iran war tests India's multi-alignment diplomacy
entries.snippet: New Delhi is proud of its carefully balanced ties with rival nations in the Middle East. But this diplomatic strategy might be reaching its breaking point.

entries.title: World Cup final halftime show will feature Madonna, Shakira and BTS
entries.snippet: Three major performers from pop, past and present, will perform during halftime of the World Cup final this year. The Superbowl-style pageant will eat into the time to analyze the biggest football game in four years.

entries.title: Tunisia sliding into authoritarianism, experts say
entries.snippet: The Tunisian government is ramping up pressure on opposition figures, journalists and civil society — raising fresh fears of deepening repression and the steady dismantling of democracy.

entries.title: Japan: Saving elderly people from 'lonely deaths'
entries.snippet: As Japanese society changes, many elderly people find themselves isolated and facing a "lonely death." Government agencies and private groups are working hard to give them a new lease on life.

entries.title: Latvia: Prime Minister Evika Silina resigns over handling of drone incidents after coalition ally's withdrawal
entries.snippet: Evika Silina says she is resigning her post, following the defense minister's resignation and the coalition government's collapse amid controversy over Ukrainian drones aimed at Russia that landed in the Baltic country.

entries.title: Germany news: Merkel urges patience for Merz's coalition
entries.snippet: Former Chancellor Angela Merkel says she thinks people need to have patience with the coalition government, amid widespread dissatisfaction. Meanwhile, Germany's men are celebrating Father's Day.

entries.title: Iran war tensions, oil shocks dominate BRICS talks in India
entries.snippet: The BRICS bloc faces major challenges as foreign ministers meet in India, bringing Iran and the UAE face-to-face. The conflict in the Gulf and disruptions to oil supplies dominate the agenda.

entries.title: Honda reports first loss since 1957 as it waters down EV strategy, but shares rise on 2026 forecasts
entries.snippet: The Japanese carmaker pursued an aggressive switch towards electric vehicles that it's now trying to walk back. Despite posting its first loss since 1957, its share price spiked on more buoyant predictions for 2026.
